## Shared scenes

> [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md), and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss the recent funeral of [Myra Murray](../character/myra-murray.md) and gossip about local church business and parish families. [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) finishes her knitting and runs down to [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where she tells [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) about Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/davis.md) leaving the church and the potential loss of ministry salary. Horrified at the thought of having to move away from [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary, [Faith](../character/faith.md) decides she must act to convince [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) to return to the congregation.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP

> [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) walks through [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) toward the [West](../character/west.md) home, reflecting on how he has grown to love [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) and resolved to propose to her. He reflects on his past widowhood, community expectations, and his genuine fondness for both sisters, knowing [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) will be away for the evening. Meanwhile, [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) dreads his arrival, bound by a solemn childhood promise made over her mother's Bible to [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) never to marry.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD

> [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) returns home from a party feeling content after winning a friendly debate with [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md). When she arrives, [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reveals that Mr. Meredith proposed to her, but [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) strictly refuses to release [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) from her vow not to marry, despite Rosemary's pleas. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) subsequently writes a cold refusal letter to [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), leaving both Meredith and [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) heartbroken while [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) tries to justify keeping her sister to herself.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXII. ST. GEORGE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT

> [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) confronts [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) at the spring in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), asking her to release [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) from her past vow so they can marry, to which [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) agrees. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) returns home and informs [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) of the encounter, releasing her from the promise. However, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) refuses to marry Norman if [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) remains living alone on the hill, leaving their future uncertain.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE

> [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) gossips with [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) about local rumors, including [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) West's refusal to marry their father and Carl's prank involving an eel and Mrs. [Carr](../character/carr.md). After Mr. Meredith hears about the prank, he confronts [Carl](../character/carl.md) and intends to whip him, but finds himself unable to go through with the punishment when he looks into Carl's eyes. [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) later witnesses her father's deep anguish alone in his dark study.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXXIII. CARL IS—NOT—WHIPPED

> Determined to make her unhappy father happy, [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) visits her late mother's gray dress in the spare room before walking to the [West](../character/west.md) house to speak with [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md). Thinking stepmothers are cruel, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) selflessly begs [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) to marry her father and promises that the children will behave. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reassures [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), writes a letter agreeing to meet [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), and sends [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) back to the manse to deliver it.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXXIV. UNA VISITS THE HILL
